main_text.l: הָבַר purificari, לְהָבֵר ad purificandum, Infin. Hiph. הָבְרוּ purificate, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. בָּרַר.
הִבָּרֵאךְ creari te, Infin. Niph. aff. R. בָּרָא.
הִבָּרוּ purificamini, Imper. Niph. pl. m. R. בָּרַר.
לְהַבְרוֹת ad ribandum[?], Infin. Hiph. Rad. בָּרָה.
הַבְּרִים, הַבְּרִי observantes, pl. m. Ben. Kal, Rad. הָבַר.
הָגַד nunciatum est, הָגֵּד nunciando, praet & Infin. Hoph. הָגְּדְתִּי indicavi, praet. Hiph. 1. f. Rad. נָגַד.
הָגָה meditari, Infin. Kal, הָגוּת meditatio, No. f. fæm. Rad. הָגָה.
הָגוֹן rectum, הַגִּינָה recta, No. Rad. הָגַן.
הִגִּיד indicavit, הִגִּידוּ indicaverunt, praet. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. & הִגִּיד indica, הִגִּירוּ indicate, Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָגַד.
הָגִּיּוֹן, & הֲגִיּוֹן meditatio, No. Rad. הָגָה meditatus est.
הִגִּיעַ pervenire fecit, הִגִּיעוּ pervenire fecerunt, praet. Hiph. 3. f & pl. m. Rad. נָגַע.
הִגְרִיד fudit, הִגְרִיתִי fudi, praet. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. Item, הַגְרֵם fun-de eos, Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. Rad. נָגַר.
הִגִּישׁ accedere fecit, ipsum, 3. sing. masc. aff. & הִגִּישׁוּ accedere fecerunt, 3. pl. praet. Hiph. Rad. נָגַשׁ.
הָגִיתָ meditatus es, הָגִיתִי sum, 2. f. m. & 1. f. praet. Kal, Rad. הָגָה.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew consonants are small and uncertain in the scan; Hebrew forms are best readings. "ribandum" (left column) is doubtful: the initial letter is unclear, possibly "tibandum". "הָגִיג" in the last left entry is cut at the column foot, so the entry is incomplete. The top right line "Rad. הָנַג, vel הָגָה" may be read as "הָגַג". The right column entry "הָגְלוּ deportaverunt" continues with the form "הָגְלִיתִי" at the foot of the column, which may be a separate line. Several Hebrew forms are marked by context only.
